Fast preset for overall tuning. Advanced Mode exposes the full control set, and manual edits to preset-owned advanced settings switch this to CUSTOM.
Shows the full tuning controls. Presets remain the simple entry point; manual edits to preset-owned advanced settings switch Preset to CUSTOM.
Base preset used for CUSTOM tuning after advanced preset-owned settings are edited.
Use lighter tier/champion scaling when Combat Extender (or similar scaling mods) is active. Prevents double-stacking difficulty.
Skips the one-time beach wake-up tutorial ambush and marks the tutorial flow completed.
Multiplier applied to point budget. Advanced Mode only; when Advanced Mode is OFF, Preset values are authoritative.
Scales ambush point budget based on party size (fewer members = lighter ambushes, more = heavier). Always ON unless Advanced Mode is enabled - toggle only takes effect in Advanced Mode.
Enforces min/max party-level gates for ambush templates. Advanced Mode only; this is a global guardrail and is not preset-owned.
Applies per-ambush power-class caps to prevent too many heavy units at once. Advanced Mode only; this is a global guardrail and is not preset-owned.
Choose the progression track used for scaling. Extended 13-20 is for level-cap mods; Vanilla 1-12 is for default BG3 progression.
Tracks creature-type reputation and can escalate to champions over time.
Debug-only legacy popup warning. Disabled for release; future immersive reputation presentation will use optional journal integration.
How fast negative reputation decays toward 0 on periodic decay ticks while out of combat.
Allow Ambush Checks In Vulnerable Moments
Allows hunters to strike during brief and extended respites.
Lets exposure in dangerous areas build extra ambush pressure over time, including passive travel danger checks. Turning this OFF clears stored time-in-danger buildup.
Prevents ambushes in unsafe states (dialog/cinematics/camp restrictions). Recommended ON.
If enabled, ambushes may occur in camp/safe zones. Recommended OFF for a vanilla feel.
Adds a per-player cooldown between ambushes. Advanced Mode only; Preset controls this when Advanced Mode is OFF.
Cooldown duration in minutes. Advanced Mode only; Preset controls this when Advanced Mode is OFF.
Debug-only test override for brief-respite ambush chance. Normal play uses preset-owned pacing.
Debug-only test override for extended-respite ambush chance. Normal play uses preset-owned pacing.
Debug-only test override for brief-respite ambush delay. Normal play uses preset-owned pacing.
Debug-only test override for brief-respite ambush delay. Normal play uses preset-owned pacing.
Debug-only test override for extended-respite ambush delay. Normal play uses preset-owned pacing.
Debug-only test override for extended-respite ambush delay. Normal play uses preset-owned pacing.
Tester helper (runtime override): forces 100% ambush chance, immediate vulnerability checks (0 minute delay), and disables cooldown without rewriting saved sliders.
Master toggle for the ambush and retaliation system.
Use the built-in vanilla enemy list. Turn OFF only if an external provider or compatibility patch is installed; otherwise ambushes may have no valid enemy pool.
Runs the ambush surprise check for eligible party members when combat starts. Party members that pass the Perception check or have immunity effects are not surprised.
Debug-only legacy popup toggle. Release presentation avoids modal/message popups; arrival cues still play independently.
Debug-only legacy pre-ambush text popup. Disabled for release; future immersive presentation will use optional journal integration.
Debug-only legacy champion popup. Disabled for release; future immersive presentation will use optional journal integration.

Controls ambient arrival cues for spawned ambushers. Balanced uses the tier chance table. Always On forces cue attempts for visibility. Off disables extra arrival cues and keeps only the baseline spawn VFX fallback.
Scales Balanced arrival-cue chance from 0% to 200%. Ignored when Arrival Cue Policy is Always On or Off.

Controls how ambushers pick spawn locations. Auto uses out-of-sight placement for the anchor and spread placement for support spawns when possible. Find Valid Only skips CreateOutOfSight. Create OOS Only only uses CreateOutOfSight.
Allows non-champion ambushers to attempt fleeing after prolonged combat. Detailed escape chance/timing is preset-owned in normal play.
Debug-only escape timing override. Normal play uses preset-owned escape tuning.
Debug-only escape DC override. Normal play uses preset-owned escape tuning.
Debug-only escape HP threshold override. Normal play uses preset-owned escape tuning.
Debug-only escape cap override. Normal play uses preset-owned escape tuning.
Ambush XP as a percent of normal enemy XP. Advanced Mode only; when Advanced Mode is OFF, Preset values are authoritative.
If enabled, ambush corpses stay interactable but generated ambush loot is cleared while normal corpse interaction and equipped gear remain. Preset baseline: Wayfarer/Marked/Relentless OFF, Hunted ON.
If enabled, champions can keep loot even when generated ambush loot is disabled. Preset baseline: Wayfarer/Marked/Relentless ON, Hunted OFF.
Adds verbose Hunted diagnostics to Script Extender logs. Enable when testing or reporting bugs.
Adds extra safety guards/logging to reduce edge-case errors (recommended OFF unless troubleshooting).
Expert/debug override. 0 = Auto scaling. >0 forces a fixed encounter budget and can easily unbalance progression.
